summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by UK bank NatWest Group plc, reporting a routine PDMR share sale under UK MAR. CEO Emma Crystal sold 50,000 ordinary shares at £5.8964 on 28 May 2026 on the London Stock Exchange. No corporate special situation (acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, restructuring, etc.) is present. The filing merely satisfies SEC disclosure obligations for a foreign private issuer's insider transaction. No terms, advisors, or structural elements of a transformative event exist.
